Deja Blue by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 A hidden treasure of scenic 30A, Deja Blue is just a two-minute walk to all of the action, yet tucked away in the relaxing low-traffic neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach. Directly out back is your own private paradise, with gorgeous porch, large private pool, and lounge chairs. A home away from home, the ground floor’s amazing high-end chef’s kitchen, and large farm table is where everyone will gather. A delightful, large living room, with 60-inch TV, is also a great space to unwind. Upstairs, the primary bedroom, king, has a dual vanity, walk-in shower and tub. Down the hall, the first guest bedroom, king, shares the hall bath, and two additional guest bedrooms, queen, share a Jack and Jill bath. The third guest room has 2 twin bunk beds and a queen bed with private bath. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional.

We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 250 steps (.1 mile) to beach (Gulf Point Road Access) - 5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths - 3000 sq ft - Garage access - Wi-Fi - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Outdoor shower - 4 bikes included Overnight: - King in 2nd floor primary; bath; TV - King in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath; TV - Queen in 2nd floor guest room; shared Jack and Jill bath; TV - Queen in 2nd floor guest room; shared Jack and Jill bath; TV - 2 twin bunks and queen in 2nd floor guest room; bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
